character.description: One character, two looks. Both source images show the same person in a flat-shaded comic illustration style.

navy-night.alt: Illustrated Kishore in a navy button-up shirt, leaning on a railing at night, palm trees and city lights in the background.
navy-night.notes: Curly black hair, navy shirt with chest pockets and rolled sleeves, thin gold chain, steel wristwatch on the left wrist, cream trousers. Calm half-smile. Casual mode.

blazer-lights.alt: Illustrated Kishore in a beige blazer over a black shirt, standing in front of palm fronds strung with warm fairy lights.
blazer-lights.notes: Swept-up black hair, moustache and goatee, beige blazer with lapel pin, open-collar black shirt, silver chain, white earbud in the left ear, hands near the jacket buttons. Professional mode.
